dialogueLines.hi: Daud me dum hai, bachche? Chamakte khambe tumhara intezaar kar rahe hain!
dialogueLines.en: Got speed in those legs, kid? The glowing poles are waiting for you!

dialogueLines.hi: Kho-kho, kabaddi, mallakhamb — yeh maidan hi hamari paathshala hai!
dialogueLines.en: Kho-kho, kabaddi, mallakhamb — this ground is our true school!
